title: [Bug] Unexpected Rapid Usage Depletion on Claude Code 20x Plan
body:
**Bug Description**
My usage is getting burned up way too quickly. Light usage on the max 20x plan has me on set to use up all of my usage in just 3 days from normal usage of sonnet. My api cost tracker 3rd party tool shows that I'm using well within my old limits of usage, so it seems this is a bug or else you have secretly massively shifted the usage limits on the models, which would be shitty and unexpected. I'm assuming it's a bug though, which is why I'm reporting it here.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.1
- Feedback ID: 6a60c9f5-fe6f-4d95-9b8d-410ed7d141d1
author: CaptainCrouton89
